installation.requirement: Require golden-native-driver:field-object-metadata. Replace named-key clump traversal with typed Golden metadata lookups and the recorded record schema. Do not merely inject numbers into old ASCII partitions or call the old user-data API with renamed strings. Golden skips records with placementID0, not records with assetID0. Preserve assetID0 when placementID is nonzero. Type-based named model/effect resolution and opaque provider handles remain Golden-aware dependencies. Set bit1/value2 when flags has either sourcebit1 or sourcebit21. Set bit0/value1 iff animation_mode==1. Additional Golden flags: flagsbit0 adds value4; else flagsbit1 adds value8. Do not OR raw animation_mode into old flags, retain the old type0-only animation gate, truncate flags to8bits, or swap placement and asset IDs. In Golden mode the retired lookup returns0 and performs NO flagsOut write. NSO ordinary code is exactly movx0,xzr;ret. Steam model-creation body positively removes the placement query/transform branch after model registration and still compares an unwritten stack slot. Do not invent flagsOut=0 or preserve PS2 named-key lookup/placement as a fallback. Steam install plus authored PROVEN-code schema constants only. Never depend on NSO/private cache or copy model/carrier pointers, decoded records or selector descriptors over guest strings/structs. All old direct users and their native/inlined/translated copies must migrate atomically to this driver; renderer/model payload support is not certified by this source proof. Use the recorded Steam signed-byte index rule; no unsigned NSO substitution or invented clamp/default. Preserve the old guest key partition only as inactive legacy data in Golden mode; no prefix/name-only binding or physical selector-byte overwrite.

required_seams.requirement: Preserve selected battle-load variant, async vs sync request state, eight-descriptor cursor and packed-block consumer namespace for slot0.
